*Data principles guide the actions of managing and stewarding data to make data more reusable and well documented.*

### FAIR Principles

 - Findable
 - Accessible
 - Interoperable
 - Reusable

<br>

### CARE Principles for Indigenous Data Governance

 - Collective Benefit
 - Authority to control
 - Responsibility
 - Ethics
